campuses.title: Milan Campus — Via Darwin
campuses.text: Главный кампус в южной части Милана, район Tortona Design District — студии, лаборатории, прототайпинг-мастерские, делится локацией с NABA в рамках группы Galileo Global Education.

paragraphs: Domus Academy is a private postgraduate design school in Milan, founded in 1982 as Italy's first postgraduate design school. Established by the Mazzocchi family of Editoriale Domus during Milan's rise as a global design capital, the school was shaped by Italian masters including Ettore Sottsass, Alessandro Mendini, Andrea Branzi, Denis Santachiara and Philippe Starck, who lectured and led workshops in the early years.

The campus is located at Via Carlo Darwin 20 in Milan's Tortona Design District, alongside NABA (Nuova Accademia di Belle Arti) — both schools belong to the Galileo Global Education group since 2018 (previously Laureate Education, 2009-2018). Domus Academy is recognised by QS World University Rankings in the top 3% globally for Art & Design (#62 in 2026), and holds memberships in Cumulus Association and ADI.

The pedagogical model is 'Learning by Designing' — roughly 90% of the curriculum is built around cross-disciplinary workshops with industry brands such as Google, Samsung, PepsiCo, Bulgari, Timberland and Vogue Talents. Master's programmes span Product, Interior & Living, Urban Vision & Architectural, Interaction, Service and Visual Brand Design, plus newer streams in Design x AI and Design Futures.

The student body is 93% international, representing more than 50 nationalities. Domus Academy reports a 91% employment rate within one year of graduation and an average job search under 100 days. Notable alumni include Anna Dello Russo (fashion editor) and Neil Poulton (industrial designer). All teaching is in English.
paragraphsRu: Domus Academy — частная постдипломная школа дизайна в Милане, основана в 1982 как первая в Италии postgraduate design school. Создана семьёй Mazzocchi (издательство Editoriale Domus) в момент, когда Милан становился глобальной столицей дизайна. Раннее ядро педагогов — итальянские мастера: Ettore Sottsass, Alessandro Mendini, Andrea Branzi, Denis Santachiara, Philippe Starck.

Кампус — Via Carlo Darwin 20, район Tortona Design District. В одной локации с NABA (Nuova Accademia di Belle Arti) — обе школы с 2018 входят в группу Galileo Global Education (до этого, 2009-2018 — Laureate Education). В QS World University Rankings 2026 школа в top 3% мира по направлению Art & Design (#62), член Cumulus Association и ADI.

Педагогический подход — 'Learning by Designing': ~90% учебного процесса — кросс-дисциплинарные воркшопы с индустриальными партнёрами (Google, Samsung, PepsiCo, Bulgari, Timberland, Vogue Talents). Master's-программы: Product Design, Interior & Living Design, Urban Vision & Architectural Design, Interaction Design, Service Design, Visual Brand Design, плюс новые направления Design x AI и Design Futures.

Состав студентов — 93% международных, более 50 национальностей. Школа фиксирует 91% трудоустройства в течение года после выпуска и средний срок поиска работы менее 100 дней. Известные выпускники — Anna Dello Russo (fashion editor) и Neil Poulton (industrial designer). Обучение полностью на английском.
